label: main plate
definition: Main Plate when only one element is required to produce the final VFX work.

label: background plate
definition: Background plate for VFX work requiring multiple elements. Carries layer identification — BG or BG02.

label: foreground plate
definition: Foreground plate for VFX work requiring multiple elements. Includes layer information — FG12.

label: element plate
definition: Isolated elements of the shot — partial composites in multi-vendor shots, rotoscoped elements, CG elements delivered at production's request. Overlaps with fg; where ambiguous the choice is the user's.

label: clean plate
definition: Clean Plate to be used for cleanup work.

label: reference plate
definition: Reference Plate such as lighting reference.

label: animation
definition: Animation version sent for animation review. May be a playblast or animation over green for editorial to comp.

label: composite
definition: Composited VFX shot.

label: concept
definition: Concept.

label: final composite
definition: Special designation for final comp. The one value in the vocabulary conventionally written upper case.

label: layout
definition: Layout versions, generally sent for environment approval.

label: look dev
definition: Look development.

label: mattes and masks
definition: Mattes and masks. Conventionally references its parent plate's revision in the identifying description — mp-v023.

label: previs
definition: Pre visualisation.

label: proxy
definition: Proxy. Definition provided by the user.

label: postvis
definition: Post visualisation.

label: reposition
definition: Repositioning, sent for editorial approval.

label: effects pass
definition: Effects pass. May be a playblast or animation over green for editorial to comp.

label: test
definition: Test shots and slap comps.

label: retime
definition: Retime approvals, sent for editorial approval.

label: virtual camera
definition: Virtual camera.

label: custom
definition: Any category not addressed by the specification. <code> is defined by the parties exchanging data — other-magic.
